_comment: Universal Golden Path template for multi-iteration dispatches. The engine reads this file when --dispatch-template is passed, substitutes {{iteration_number}}, {{iteration_title}}, {{subject_entity}}, {{counterparty_entity}}, {{setting_context}}, {{timeline_anchor}}, and {{operator_choice}} from the previous iteration's decision_history.json (when running iteration >= 2), then dispatches the resulting master objective as if the user had typed it on the command line. Domain-agnostic: works for release trains, research programs, audit cycles, design-system evolutions, product lineups, report series, and any other repeating workflow that benefits from a shared template.
name: iteration_pattern

substitutions.iteration_number: 1-based iteration number (read from the dispatch flag or auto-incremented from state/decision_history.json)
substitutions.iteration_title: Free-text title, e.g. 'Q1 Roll-up' or 'Cohort B' or 'Spec 2'
substitutions.subject_entity: Primary entity this iteration is about, e.g. 'payment-svc API contract' or '2025 brand guidelines' or 'Q4 financial close'
substitutions.counterparty_entity: Secondary entity, e.g. 'mobile-app client team' or 'regulator (FCA)' or 'audit committee'
substitutions.setting_context: Setting name + region + era, e.g. 'EMEA production, 2025 H1' or 'public preview, week 4'
substitutions.timeline_anchor: Time anchor, e.g. '11 days after the migration cutover' or '48 hours before the regulatory filing deadline'
substitutions.operator_choice: The most recent Gate 2 (CRITICAL) decision from state/decision_history.json, formatted as 'the operator chose: <deepen constraint | hold the line | off-screen resolution>'. Empty string on iteration 1.

deliverables.name: primary_deliverable
deliverables.description: Primary written artifact. Must reference the timeline anchor in section 1 and resolve (or escalate) the prior iteration's dangling thread.

deliverables.name: structured_data_export
deliverables.description: Structured data export (the canonical machine-readable form of the primary deliverable). Carry forward unchanged data from prior iterations verbatim.

deliverables.name: visual_or_diagram
deliverables.description: 60-90 second visual / diagram. Must include one signature element (the {{setting_context}} equivalent of 'the lighthouse foghorn' or 'the dashboard hero number').

deliverables.name: supporting_analysis
deliverables.description: Supporting analysis (notebook, deep-dive doc, regression write-up). Cross-link to the primary deliverable and the visual.

deliverables.name: test_or_verification
deliverables.description: Verification script or test harness. Must include at least one assertion against the {{subject_entity}} contract.

deliverables.name: audit_and_decisions_log
deliverables.description: Append-only decision log. Carries forward every prior-iteration decision verbatim; adds this iteration's decisions.

deliverables.name: continuity_report
deliverables.description: Per-rule pass/fail with citations back to the primary deliverable. Written by the Continuity Engine.

hitl_gates.ask: Approve the primary deliverable for downstream generation? (approve and continue pre-approves the rest of the routine gates)
Operator checkpoint: should the {{counterparty_entity}} learn about the {{subject_entity}}'s status? (Deepen the constraint / Hold the line / Off-screen resolution)
Approve the final pack for delivery to $VORTEX_HOME/deliverables/{{project}}/? (Approving writes .manifest.json and freezes the deliverables)

self_heal_targets: Tone drift (the deliverable suddenly shifts in formality vs. the prior iterations)
Anachronism (a reference or version that doesn't fit the {{setting_context}} era)
Contract violation ({{subject_entity}} acts against an established constraint from a prior iteration)
Duplicate fact (the same datum stated twice with conflicting detail)
Visual / diagram inconsistency (location described in primary deliverable not present in the visual)
